title: Taking Stock Without Stopping — Arche
description: Chandy and Lamport's distributed snapshots: three trading houses count what they hold while the carts keep moving, with messengers in red sashes, and the total describes a morning nobody lived through.
question: How do you take stock of a whole system that never stops moving, when no one can see all of it at once? And what can such a count reliably tell you?
how: We find out by exploring how ancient Greek trading houses, hearing that bandits were taking their carts, counted every jar they owned, including those in transit, without interrupting ongoing trades.

papers.authors: K. Mani Chandy and Leslie Lamport
papers.title: Distributed Snapshots: Determining Global States of Distributed Systems
